Subject: Platform & Ops Rescope — leadership comms draft

Team —

Attached is a first-pass leadership comms draft announcing the proposed rescope of Platform and Ops pillars ahead of the QBR. Goal: give Execs a concise narrative we can present to staff next week and an FAQ for managers. Key asks inline below.

High-level changes (one-pager attached):
- Consolidate "Platform Core" + "Runtime Optimization" into a single Platform pillar focused on serving reliability and unit cost reductions.
- Move SLO/observability ownership into Ops (to centralize incident response and runbook ownership).
- Create a new small "Performance & Cost" squad under Platform for batching/quantization initiatives.

Immediate asks:
1) Review the opening paragraph (tone + framing) and suggest edits by EOD Wed.
2) Add any manager-level FAQs we should pre-seed.
3) Confirm the risk paragraph around role dual-hatting — I want it explicit without being alarmist.

Attached: rescope_onepager.pdf, qbr_talking_points.md, timeline-slide.png

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Platform Strategy | Redwood Inference

Quick pass from me: overall +1 on the framing. A few concrete notes inline (I pasted short comments below).

Inline notes:
- Opening paragraph: I recommend we lead with customer impact (latency & cost wins) before the org-level change — helps with optics.
- "Performance & Cost" squad name: maybe "Serving Efficiency" — signals measurable OKRs (p50/p95 token cost).
- Risk paragraph: add a line about transition headcount being neutral for Q3 (i.e., we prioritize lateral moves vs new hires).

FAQ suggestion: managers will ask about career ladders. Add a short blurb: "No automatic relevels; managers will review role definitions in 30 days."

I can do a quick copy edit and return a tracked version by Tue morning.

— Jonas

A couple of manager-level FAQ items I want included:
- When will team-level OKRs be reissued? (Answer: within two weeks of announcement; draft templates to managers).
- What do we do about active projects that overlap the old pillars? (Answer: transition plan with milestones and owner handoff docs).

Also, small ask: can we avoid using the word "reorg" in the all-hands slide—use "realignment" or "refocus". That reduces anxiety.
